prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Australian woman — the personification of the city of Sydney — one woman who IS Sydney as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; deep brown skin; gently long oval face; eyes of natural size — almond eyes whose outer corners lift slightly, outer eye corners slightly lifted; full brows set slightly low over the eyes; a straight nose with a slim bridge; a mouth of natural width whose corners lift easily; honey-gold eyes; glossy nude lips.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; short cropped hair with no bangs, forehead bare; silver-white hair flashing pale ion-blue at the ends like a strobe.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a sleek rescue suit split into the red and yellow halves of the beach's safe-swimming flags, the two colours glowing along its light seams; small flag-shaped panels of red and yellow light at her shoulders, rippling in the sea wind like the patrol flags on the sand.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a rescue suit banded with reflective strips, a medical-drone holster at the hip and sturdy boots — a sturdy, ready-to-move rescue silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: harbour blue, sail white, jacaranda violet — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a slim rescue float glowing in red and yellow light, its tether coiled at her hip; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Sydney two centuries from now, a far-future harbour city: the great steel arch bridge and the white sail-shelled hall of song on its point kept exactly as they stand, slow patterns of light washing across the shells; slender towers of white ceramic and glass terraced around the many coves, their hanging gardens full of jacaranda in violet bloom; transparent glass ferries gliding silently on glowing lanes across the deep-blue harbour; along the ocean shore a golden crescent beach where rescue drones hover over the surf between flags of red and yellow light, a rock-cut ocean pool glowing at its southern end; quiet flying vehicles in lanes over the water and the far mountains a blue haze under a clear sky.
This card: on the golden crescent beach at dawn patrol, two tall flags of red and yellow light planted in the sand beside her and rescue drones hovering over the breaking surf.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

qa.anatomy: Natural standing stance with both hands in frame.
observations: User-selected candidate 1. Silver crop, amber eyes and split red-yellow rescue gear read clearly. The arch, shell roofs and patrol flags are visible.

acceptance: User selected candidate 1 and authorized fast-forward integration into main.
